name: Corpus Proxy Exchange
backstory: The Exchange buys machines the way other firms buy securities: in complementary lots. Three light proxies establish the account; three Bursas turn it into a six-unit enforcement portfolio.
strategy_personality: Buy the light proxy trio first, then Denial protection, followed by a funded Drover-and-Isolator purchase sequence. Use a varied six-machine roster rather than returning to the old three-robot Tycoon target.

original_record.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around EVERY extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.

Subject: Authentic standard green Corpus MOA from Warframe: compact armless bird-like mechanical walker on TWO reverse-jointed legs, broad claw feet, green source armour and black mechanisms, distinctive top-mounted weapon and low sensor assembly. Preserve actual source geometry. One short-range arena emitter in the existing weapon mount, no human torso or arms.
Catalogue label for metadata only, do not render text: #113 slot 1 Scrip MOA.
original_record.visual_review: Accepted — complete framing, limb count, equipment representation and shared portrait style checked.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** Warframe  
**Strategy:** Squadron · **Target roster:** 6 robots  
**Opening:** 3 robots · **Hard cap:** 6 robots  
**Catalogue key:** `corpus-proxy-exchange`

**Proposed robots:** Scrip MOA; Ledger MOA; Margin MOA; Escrow Bursa; Dividend Bursa; Audit Bursa.

**Source edition:** Standard Corpus MOA, Railgun MOA, Fusion MOA, and the three standard Bursa variants; exclude Juno, Vapos, Eximus, and cosmetic variants.

**Naming:** All six robot names are original arena unit labels. Their source identities are the machine classes in the table; the names do not imply named Warframe characters.

**Backstory:** The Exchange buys machines the way other firms buy securities: in complementary lots. Three light proxies establish the account; three Bursas turn it into a six-unit enforcement portfolio.

**Purchasing personality:** Buy the light proxy trio first, then Denial protection, followed by a funded Drover-and-Isolator purchase sequence. Use a varied six-machine roster rather than returning to the old three-robot Tycoon target.

**Robot blueprints**

| Slot | Arena robot name | Source identity | Joins | Arena role | Loadout | Stance / yield | Build_Focus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Scrip MOA** | MOA | Opening | Mobile line shooter | `single` | balanced / 15% | Versatile |
| 2 | **Ledger MOA** | Railgun MOA | Opening | Precision support | `single` | balanced / 20% | Deadeye |
| 3 | **Margin MOA** | Fusion MOA | Opening | Sustained fire | `two_handed` | offensive / 10% | Bruiser |
| 4 | **Escrow Bursa** | Denial Bursa | Growth #1 | Defensive anchor | `weapon_shield` | defensive / 25% | Warden |
| 5 | **Dividend Bursa** | Drover Bursa | Growth #2 | Close pressure | `two_handed` | offensive / 10% | Bruiser |
| 6 | **Audit Bursa** | Isolator Bursa | Growth #3 | Protected fire support | `weapon_shield` | defensive / 20% | Tactician |

**Weapon paths** — stage 0 on recruitment, then stage 1. Prices are combined list-price equipment subtotals, not total robot or stable purchase costs.

| Slot | Range from weapons | Stage 0 | Stage 1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | short | Laser Pistol (₡57,000) | Volt Sabre (₡425,000) |
| 2 | long | Beam Pistol (₡93,000) | Particle Lance (₡425,000) |
| 3 | mid | Training Rifle (₡50,000) | Plasma Cannon (₡408,000) |
| 4 | short | Laser Pistol + Light Shield (₡108,000) | Volt Sabre + Aegis Bulwark (₡834,000) |
| 5 | short | Scatter Cannon (₡84,000) | Arc Projector (₡488,000) |
| 6 | mid | Bolt Carbine + Combat Shield (₡171,000) | Nova Caster + Aegis Bulwark (₡834,000) |

**Equipment planning totals:** opening trio ₡200,000; recruits 4–6 at stage 0 ₡363,000; all six at stage 1 ₡3,414,000; 8 equipped weapon/shield items at the six-robot target. The stage-0 equipment component of the slot-5-and-6 recruitment reserve is ₡255,000, plus both robot frames, required facilities, and maintenance reserve.

**Refinement plans — after all six robots reach stage 1**

Execute each row from left to right. Costs and workshop gates for every operation are in the [shared refinement rules](#squadron-refinement-rules). Main/offhand targets are explicit; all six robots have a non-empty plan.

| Slot | Robot | Ordered refinement steps | Refinement subtotal |
|---|---|---|---:|
| 1 | **Scrip MOA** | Main Volt Sabre: Hone Combat Power 8→10 → Main Volt Sabre: Augment Adaptive AI +3 (new) → Main Volt Sabre: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Volt Sabre: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡920,000 |
| 2 | **Ledger MOA** | Main Particle Lance: Hone Targeting Systems 8→10 → Main Particle Lance: Augment Weapon Control +3 (new) → Main Particle Lance: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Particle Lance: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡920,000 |
| 3 | **Margin MOA** | Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Combat Power 7→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Critical Systems 6→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Augment Hull Integrity +3 (new) → Main Plasma Cannon: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Plasma Cannon: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,130,000 |
| 4 | **Escrow Bursa** | Offhand Aegis Bulwark: Hone Evasion Thrusters −5→0 → Main Volt Sabre: Hone Combat Power 8→10 → Main Volt Sabre: Augment Adaptive AI +3 (new) → Main Volt Sabre: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Volt Sabre: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,170,000 |
| 5 | **Dividend Bursa** | Main Arc Projector: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Arc Projector: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡700,000 |
| 6 | **Audit Bursa** | Offhand Aegis Bulwark: Hone Evasion Thrusters −5→0 → Main Nova Caster: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Nova Caster: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡950,000 |

**Refinement budget:** ₡5,790,000 across six robots. Final stage-1 equipment plus refinement totals ₡9,204,000; stage-0 purchases and facility, frame, training, and maintenance costs are additional.

**Portrait blueprints** — show one complete body using the shared art direction. Signature features identify the source; every active weapon or shield must map to the equipment allocations above.

| Slot | Portrait and equipment brief |
|---|---|
| 1 | Standard MOA walker: preserve its inverted-knee legs, source sensor assembly, and weapon mount. One short-range arena emitter; no invented humanoid arms. |
| 2 | Use the standard Railgun MOA model and its distinctive source cannon assembly. One long-range emitter in the existing mount; preserve the walker silhouette. |
| 3 | Use the Fusion MOA source body and its larger gun assembly. A single heavy mid-range arena weapon consumes the two-handed equipment allocation; depict no extra deployed drone. |
| 4 | Standard Denial Bursa body, frontal protection, and source locomotion. One short-range weapon and one represented shield item; frontal plates do not provide extra free shield statistics. |
| 5 | Use the standard Drover Bursa chassis and source armament silhouette. One heavy short-range arena emitter; retain the machine body rather than adding hands. |
| 6 | Standard Isolator Bursa body with recognizable frontal protection. One mid-range emitter and one shield allocation; source nullification effects remain narrative flavour. |

**Named teams and fixed membership** — all names are original Armoured Souls team labels.

| Format | Team name | Fixed members | Forms |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2v2 | **Margin Call** | 1 Scrip MOA + 2 Ledger MOA | Opening trio |
| 2v2 | **Liquid Assets** | 3 Margin MOA + 4 Escrow Bursa | When slot 4 joins |
| 2v2 | **Hostile Takeover** | 5 Dividend Bursa + 6 Audit Bursa | When slot 6 joins |
| 3v3 | **Proxy Prospectus** | 1 Scrip MOA + 2 Ledger MOA + 3 Margin MOA | Opening trio |
| 3v3 | **Bursa Board** | 4 Escrow Bursa + 5 Dividend Bursa + 6 Audit Bursa | When slot 6 joins |

**Shared parameters:** apply the Squadron recruitment, fixed-team, event-order, budget, tuning, refinement, and image rules below. Slots 1–3 open together; buy 4, then 5, then 6. No reserve slots or substitution alternatives are included.

References: [official Bursa identities](https://www.warframe.com/en/patch-notes/pc/18-4-10), [original production concept reference](https://www.warframe.com/en/news/operation-false-profit-1), [secondary Corpus machine roster](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Corpus_Tech/Vapos_Tech).
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–3. Recruit slot 4, then fund the complete slot-5/slot-6 pair before buying 5 followed by 6. Finish all six final loadouts before refinement. Invest in slot order 1,4,2,5,3,6, with Hone, Augment, first Sharpen and first Forge passes through Workshop L1, L3, L5 and L8. Keep funding and prestige-gated steps pending.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, upkeep, repair costs, discounts and resale. Alternatives excluded.
